prompt.countingScope: Pinned LlmInference.sizeInTokens on exact full string;template included. Difference is observed,not additive special-token/BOS claim;internal prefill tensor length UNKNOWN

output.streamedText: Matrix multiplication calculates the dot product of two vectors, but for matrices. It results in a new matrix where each element is the dot product of the corresponding rows of the first matrix and the columns of the second matrix.
